summary: This bill codifies into law the Environmental Protection Agency's final rule establishing a national primary drinking water regulation for PFAS, as it existed on June 25, 2024.

scores.thoughts: This bill codifies a national primary drinking water regulation for PFAS, which are harmful chemicals. By establishing and enforcing standards for these contaminants in drinking water, the bill directly contributes to environmental protection and public health, aligning with the 'more environmental protection' end of the spectrum.
